lines.text: HEY! You made it. I watched your run - consistent, useful, real. You earned this.
Application reviewed. Engage Points verified. Stander - you are approved for the @SEED role.
It is real. But SEED is not the destination - it is the entry gate. Now you choose a Squad.
Dan. Creative Squad. Speaks little, but when he ships, the standard changes. That is the level you will chase.
Choose a Squad. Each path has responsibilities. Which route is yours?
Select your Squad. This decision persists in your local profile.
